stories.summary: LONDON, -- Young William's luck in politics has proved too good to last. All at once it has come to an abrupt and sensational end. Lifelong observers say there has been no such furious storm of partisan feeling in the Prussian Diet since the great battle over the army organization nearly thirty years ago as this which is now shaking Berlin.

stories.headline: For Obama, Big Rise in Poll Numbers After Bin Laden Raid
stories.summary: A majority now approves of the president’s overall job performance, as well as his handling of foreign policy, according to the latest New York Times/CBS News poll.
